// Strict installed-tarball consumer; the producer contracts are frozen separately.
import type { Access, Connection, IssueTracker, PullRequests, ReleaseSource } from "@lutzseverino/postern";
import type * as Published from "./published-1.0.0.js";

const unused = (): never => { throw new Error("compile fixture only"); };

// Actual 1.0.0 producers: no event normalization, pagination or label management.
const publishedTracker: Published.IssueTracker = {
  capabilities: {},
  issues: unused,
  issue: unused,
  labelChanges: unused,
  comments: unused,
  addLabels: unused,
  removeLabel: unused,
  createLabel: unused,
  createComment: unused,
  updateComment: unused,
  closeIssue: unused,
};
const publishedAccess: Published.Access = {
  capabilities: {},
  viewer: unused,
  role: unused,
  request: unused,
};
declare const pullRequests: Published.PullRequests;
declare const releaseSource: Published.ReleaseSource;
const publishedConnection: Published.Connection = {
  repository: { platform: "github", host: "github.com", path: "octo/hello" },
  issueTracker: publishedTracker,
  pullRequests,
  releaseSource,
  access: publishedAccess,
};
export const legacyTracker: IssueTracker = publishedTracker;
export const legacyAccess: Access = publishedAccess;
export const legacyConnection: Connection = publishedConnection;

// Identity checks protect signatures, optionality and readonly requirements,
// including nested facts and capability flags, independently of assignability.
type Equal<A, B> =
  (<T>() => T extends A ? 1 : 2) extends (<T>() => T extends B ? 1 : 2) ? true : false;
type Assert<T extends true> = T;
// A new optional capability flag is additive; all published flags, members,
// signatures and readonly requirements must still match exactly.
type LegacyTrackerShape = {
  [K in keyof IssueTracker]: K extends "capabilities"
    ? Omit<IssueTracker[K], "subIssueLinkAdditions"> : IssueTracker[K];
};
type LegacyConnectionShape = {
  [K in keyof Connection]: K extends "issueTracker" ? LegacyTrackerShape : Connection[K];
};
export type TrackerMatchesPublished = Assert<Equal<LegacyTrackerShape, Published.IssueTracker>>;
export type AccessMatchesPublished = Assert<Equal<Access, Published.Access>>;
export type ConnectionMatchesPublished = Assert<Equal<LegacyConnectionShape, Published.Connection>>;
export type PullRequestsMatchesPublished = Assert<Equal<PullRequests, Published.PullRequests>>;
export type ReleaseSourceMatchesPublished = Assert<Equal<ReleaseSource, Published.ReleaseSource>>;
export type LegacyTrackerHasNoAdditions = Assert<
  Extract<keyof IssueTracker, "issueEvent" | "labels" | "updateLabel"> extends never ? true : false
>;
export type LegacyAccessHasNoAdditions = Assert<
  Extract<keyof Access, "requestPages"> extends never ? true : false
>;
